welcome.title: Open a game folder
welcome.hint: Choose the folder of the MuMain client (Mu Online season 6). The item names are in its item data folder {path}, which is found automatically:
welcome.fallbackHint: This browser cannot edit files in place (use Chrome or Edge for that). Choose the game folder (or its Data/Items folder) to work on a copy of the item files kept in this browser; Save (Ctrl+S) downloads the updated files for you to copy back into Data/Items.

topbar.translatorTitle: This name is written to the change log
topbar.reloadTitle: Read the item files again from disk
topbar.browserCopyTitle: This browser cannot write to your folders, so you are editing a copy stored in the browser. Saving downloads the updated item files - copy them into the game's Data/Items folder.
topbar.layoutTitle: Item data: {folder} ({files} files, {items} items). Translating into "{locale}".

groups.label: Item groups
groups.progressTitle: {named} of {items} items have a Vietnamese name

toolbar.search: Search name or English name (accents optional), 7:1, #3585 · Enter to edit

issueDetail.too-long: The name is {chars} characters, over the {max}-character limit (the game would cut it).
issueDetail.control-char: The name contains control characters (tab, newline, 0x00…).
issueDetail.lone-surrogate: The name contains a broken Unicode character (lone surrogate).
issueDetail.edge-whitespace: The name has spaces at the start or end.
issueDetail.double-space: The name has two spaces in a row.
issueDetail.separator: The name must not contain "{'||'}" (MuMain uses it to separate languages).

detail.label: Item details
detail.none: Select a row to see details.
detail.help: Enter / Tab: save and go to the next row · Shift+Enter: previous row · Esc: cancel · empty name = not translated (the game shows English) · Ctrl+S: save
detail.notePlaceholder: Note for the team (Enter to save)

translatorDialog.title: Translator name
translatorDialog.body: This name is saved with every change in the change log (changes.tsv), so when translations from several people are merged later you can tell who changed what.
translatorDialog.label: Name or nickname

discardDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discardDialog.body: {n} change has not been saved to the item files. If you continue, it will be lost. | {n} changes have not been saved to the item files. If you continue, they will be lost.

draftDialog.title: Restore unsaved changes?
draftDialog.body: Your previous session (draft saved {time}) has {n} change that was not saved to the item files. | Your previous session (draft saved {time}) has {n} changes that were not saved to the item files.
draftDialog.baseChanged: Note: the names in the item files have changed since then (Google Drive may have synced). The draft names will be applied to the current files – review them with the "Edited" filter.

conflictDialog.title: The file was changed outside this tool
conflictDialog.body: Overwriting keeps your names and loses that change (the version on disk is still backed up first). Or cancel, reload the folder and redo your edits.

toast.backup: Rewrote {files}; the previous versions were backed up to {path}
toast.nothingToSave: There are no changes to save.
toast.restoredSkipped: Skipped {n} invalid name. | Skipped {n} invalid names.
toast.exported: Exported {n} row to {file}. | Exported {n} rows to {file}.
toast.imported: Imported {n} change. Review and save. | Imported {n} changes. Review and save.
toast.rebased: The names in the item files were changed from outside since your last save (e.g. a new master copy). Merge bases were reset to the current names.
toast.statusSet: Marked {n} row as {status}. | Marked {n} rows as {status}.
toast.otherTab: This folder is also open in another tab. Each tab keeps its own changes, so saving in both would overwrite one with the other - keep one tab.
toast.downloaded: Downloaded {file} - copy it into the game's Data/Items folder.
toast.downloadedZip: Downloaded Items.zip ({file}) - unzip it into the game's Data/Items folder.

errors.dirty: {count} change has not been saved yet. | {count} changes have not been saved yet.
errors.conflict: {file} was changed on disk after you opened it (Google Drive may have just synced, someone else saved it, or MuMain's item editor wrote it). Overwriting would lose that change.
errors.save-verify-failed: The final check before writing failed – nothing was saved.
errors.file-locked: Cannot write {file}: another program is holding it (is the game client or MuMain's editor running?). Close it and save again.
errors.permission-denied: No permission to read or write the file.
errors.is-directory: That path is a folder, not a file.
errors.not-a-file: That path is not a regular file.
errors.picker-unsupported: No native file dialog on this system (on Linux, install zenity or kdialog) – paste the path instead.
errors.picker-failed: Could not open the file dialog: {detail}
errors.offline: Lost connection to MuBMD-editor. Is its command-line window still running?
errors.tsv-header: The TSV file needs ItemType, ItemIndex and Name columns (found: {columns}).
errors.import-changed: {file} changed after the preview – preview it again.
errors.fs-unsupported: This browser cannot edit files in place. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.
errors.item-json: {file} is not a valid item file: {detail}
errors.items-not-found: No item data was found in “{folder}”. Choose the game folder (with Data/Items, or Main.app on macOS), or the Data/Items folder itself.
errors.no-item: There is no item in slot {slot}.

status.label: Status
status.shortcut: Alt+1 / Alt+2 / Alt+3 on the list

actions.markList: Mark the {n} listed row as | Mark the {n} listed rows as

exportDialog.title: Export translations
exportDialog.body: Creates a TSV file (opens in Excel / Google Sheets) with names, status, translator, note, the English name and the merge base, so another copy can import it without losing anyone's work.
exportDialog.mineHint: Changed by "{name}" since the file you started from.

importDialog.title: Import translations
importDialog.noBase: This file has no BaseName column (an older or hand-made file), so conflicts cannot be detected: every different name is listed as a change. Review before applying.
importDialog.summary: {apply} to apply · {conflict} conflicts · {status} status changes · {invalid} invalid
importDialog.skipped: Unchanged: {same} · newer here: {newerHere} · empty name ignored: {emptyName} · no such item here: {noItem}
importDialog.problems: {n} line was skipped (bad ItemType/ItemIndex or duplicate). | {n} lines were skipped (bad ItemType/ItemIndex or duplicate).
importDialog.nothing: Nothing to import: every row already matches this file.
importDialog.compareNote: Names that differ from the other game folder are listed; tick the ones to take from it. Items without a Vietnamese name there are ignored.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.empty: No glossary loaded. Open the team's glossary (a TSV, or the old MuMain_VI_Glossary.csv) or start a new one. The glossary is a separate file you can share on Google Drive.
glossary.legacy: This is the old CSV format and is read-only here. Saving creates a new TSV file; the CSV is not changed.
glossary.discardBody: The glossary has changes that are not saved to its file.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of MuBMD-editor is ready.
